rationale: The published 2.4 Cloud Connect installer documents a fresh qualifying setup. The 2.3.6 feature/installation conflict and SAIA-9918 for 2.2.0–2.3.6 remain historical with a 2.1.1 workaround lacking Agent Mode. The current 2.4 Agent Mode requirements still apply.

exclusions: Scope stays with the named release and deployment. No tenant eligibility, unstated region, undocumented pairing or offering authorization is established.

remainingConcerns: Review the exact documentation and unresolved applicability with Version Release Watch on November 26. Prior issue evidence retains its original scope and time.
